reference.role: Current blue species and rendering direction; not an outfit to duplicate or a user-approved final master

visual_inspection.species: Blue skin, yellow eyes, broad short muzzle, lateral pointed ears and broad clawed feet.
visual_inspection.differentiation: Rounder scowling face, heavier lower lip and short tusks, compact fuller trunk, ochre tied headcloth and pale worn tunic; no large bone helmet or red cape.
visual_inspection.equipment: Open hide bag contains grey stones; one rounded stone held low by thigh, other arm relaxed low; no sling.
visual_inspection.clothing: Missing shoulder edge, worn holes and unequal hem with a few threads; pale coarse cloth and dark short trousers.
visual_inspection.composition: One frontal full-body figure, both feet at similar depth, no text/scenery, ivory background and clear margins.
visual_inspection.limitations: Painted muscle and texture detail remains relatively pronounced. Concept art pending user judgement; not a transparent animation master.

user_visual_approval: rejected: user states clothing and face are too human and unsuitable
